messages.author: Kalle Niskanen
messages.text: Heads up for anyone dispatched to OULU-11: I drove there this morning, the access road to OULU-11 is closed for roadworks until 20 Nov, use the forest track from the north side.

messages.author: Timo Laine
messages.text: Thanks, good to know. Is the forest track ok for the van?

messages.author: Kalle Niskanen
messages.text: Yes, it's gravel but fine, I came in that way.

notifications.text: Your tip from 2026-11-09 was proposed for OULU-11 today.
